item.text: The current implementation expires the per-user marker after the resend interval, while the confirmation record is hard-coded to one day. That makes “pending” disappear on one clock and leaves resend logic unable to distinguish the configured lifetime. I’m checking database TTL APIs and settings defaults before aligning both keys to the expiry and deriving resend eligibility from live TTL.
